entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.1.3
entry.summary: **PotentialBreaks 1.1.3**: name tidy-up. - The title on the plugin's page now reads **PotentialBreaks**, the same as in the MPC's plugin list (it was in all capitals). Sound and controls are unchanged. Saved projects keep working. **Download** `PotentialBreaks-1.1.3-mpc-armv7.zip` below. It's for Gen1 (32-bit) MPCs on MPC OS 3.x and has been tested on an MPC One. entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.1.2
entry.summary: **PotentialBreaks 1.1.2**: a new, more polished look. - Barlow fonts, raised panels with soft shadows, glowing amber knob arcs, even-sized button labels and darker display wells. The same controls in the same places. - MIDI from other tracks (for example a controller set to Global) can no longer change the plugin's settings. Q-Links still work. entry.title: PotentialBreaks 1.1.1
entry.summary: **PotentialBreaks 1.1.1**, the first public release. Dig, chop, play: a random drum break from your own library on 16 pads, chopped and matched to your tempo.
